messages:
rachel: Quick accessibility find from the model rollout diff panel review: screen readers read the mini-traffic badges twice and the color-only wedges in the traffic chart aren't exposed to assistive tech. Repro: open Rollouts > choose a rollout > Tab into the traffic summary area.
igor: thanks — saw that too. The badges are implemented as inline svgs with title + visually hidden text, but we also have aria-label on the parent span. Might be duplicating announcements.
neha: the wedges are purely decorative: <svg role="img"> with aria-hidden=false and no descriptive text. That explains the empty or repeated announcements depending on SR.
rachel: console trace while navigating: 
```
focus: set to #traffic-badge-2
aria-announcement: "10%"
aria-announcement: "Traffic 10%"
```
so SR reads both the svg title and the parent aria-label.
igor: easy fix: standardize to a single accessible node. Either make the svg aria-hidden="true" and keep a single aria-label on the parent, or remove parent label and give the svg a single <title> matched to aria-labelledby. Prefer parent label for simpler DOM.
neha: also noticed keyboard focus order: the diff table rows are focusable and then action buttons are separately tabbable, which causes two stops per row and makes keyboard nav slow. Consider making the entire row a single composite widget with arrow-key navigation and Enter for actions, or keep DOM order but collapse row-level focus so Tab goes to the next row action only.
rachel: we need consistency with other lists (Insights table uses row-level Enter to open detail). I vote to reuse that pattern: row container gets role=row and roving tabindex; Enter opens details; Tab dives into action toolbar.
a11y-bot: Automated checks: contrast-warnings=1; duplicate-aria-announcements=2; focus-visible-missing=3; svg-role-misuse=1
neha: the contrast issue is the low-contrast thin divider in the diff list (light grey on light theme). We should use tokenized divider color that meets at least AA for text-sized separators or increase thickness for decorative dividers.
igor: plan of action: (1) normalize traffic badge accessibility: keep single aria-label on wrapper, set svg aria-hidden=true; (2) standardize row keyboard model to match Insights (roving tabindex + Enter to open); (3) update CSS token for divider and add :focus-visible style for row and small icon buttons; (4) add aria-live polite update for rollout progress (only when percent changes >1%) so SR users get meaningful updates.
rachel: I'll own (1) and the small unit test verifying only one announcement is emitted when focusing the badge.
neha: I'll update tokens and CSS for divider + focus-visible snapshots.
igor: I'll refactor row behavior and run a quick sweep to ensure other tables aren't broken.
a11y-bot: RT-5010 created. severity=medium; regression-tests-needed=1
rachel: QA checklist to add to ticket RT-5010: 
- macOS VoiceOver: open rollout, Tab into traffic badges, verify single announcement and readout matches visual percentage
- Windows NVDA: same flow and verify svg is not announced separately
- Keyboard-only: Tab through rows, Arrow keys move between rows, Enter opens details, Tab moves into action buttons, Esc closes and returns focus to rollout toggle
- Low-vision: increase text scaling to 200% and verify layout doesn't hide percentages
- Automated: add jest+axe test asserting no duplicate aria announcements for the badge element
igor: can we aim for a small PR by next Tue? minor patch and tests.
neha: yes — I'll target Monday for CSS tokens.
rachel: thanks folks — attaching the console trace and a quick VoiceOver screen capture to RT-5010. :thumbsup:
